verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI media platform, but the evidence describes Pika only as a hosted web platform and hosted API, with no downloadable deployment, open weights or on-prem option. The developer platform explicitly says it serves 'hosted models' and that every generation 'runs against production,' which points away from self-hosting rather than toward it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
